response: An information system refers to a set of processes and technologies used for creating, storing, processing, managing, transmitting, collecting, and exchanging data or information in cyberspace. It is typically an organized network of hardware, software, databases, and people that work together to facilitate the flow of information within an organization or among multiple parties. The systems can be classified into various categories based on their functions, such as national important information system (which causes severe damage to national defense and security if compromised) and personal information-processing organizations and individuals responsible for protecting personal information in cyberspace.
